Pick your council on the left, put something in front of them below, and convene. In Debate mode they argue across several rounds and cut each other off; in Solo critique each one reviews your prompt independently.

Settings

The selected CLI must be installed and signed in. Model ids are passed through unchanged, so provider-specific ids work without an app update. Codex sessions authenticated through ChatGPT report token usage but not a per-turn dollar charge; the header therefore labels dollar amounts as reported cost.

When set, members may Read/Glob/Grep that directory and cite real file:line. ConclAIve sessions are restricted to read/search operations; leave this empty for pure discussion.

New council member

Any image on disk. It is scaled to 256×256 and stored inside the persona, so the pack stays portable — moving or deleting the original file will not break it. Blank shows a monogram in the accent colour.
Describe only the person: how they think, what they care about, how they argue. The council rules, brevity and codebase instructions are added automatically.
Advanced tuning
How hard this member thinks per turn. Higher levels generally take more time and usage.
Two or three lines in their voice. Showing the model how they talk does more for fidelity than describing them — it is the single most effective field here.
A private reminder appended to every turn, kept close to the model's attention. Useful for correcting a habit without rewriting the voice.

Temperature and top-p are intentionally omitted because the supported harnesses do not expose them consistently. Effort and model are passed to the selected CLI; everything above is behaviour this app implements.
